Name: RUNTIME_BONE_CONTROL_PARAM_ST
Description: Helper-bone corrections applied to a character's animated pose (twist, elbow, knee and similar bones). When a character model loads, every row whose Character Model ID matches is used, in row order.

Fields.Name: Character Model ID
Fields.Description: Model number the row applies to (c3450: 3450). 0: the player model (c0000). Every row with this number is applied to the model.

Fields.Name: Bone Control Type
Fields.Description: 0 Blend: Applicable Joint is placed halfway between Target Joints 1 and 2 (position, rotation and scale). 1 Aim: Applicable Joint is re-oriented from its own and Target Joint 1's transforms; Target Joint 2 is not used.

Fields.Name: Applicable Joint
Fields.Description: Name of the bone that is moved. Must match a bone name in the model's skeleton exactly (case-sensitive); if it, or a target needed by the type, isn't found, the row is skipped.

Fields.Name: Target Joint 1
Fields.Description: Bone name. Type 0: the first bone of the blend. Type 1: the bone the Applicable Joint is oriented from.

Fields.Name: Target Joint 2
Fields.Description: Bone name. Type 0: the second bone of the blend.
